notes: Replace paths with existing local artifacts; output_dir must be new.
batch/ubatch unsupported until an SDK runner supports them.
For QAIRT use one bundle variant per compiled context, devices=[npu], compiled_contexts=[4096], and a prompt_file.
VLM needs image_path and prompt_file; llama_cpp also needs mmproj_path.
Energy/memory capture is unavailable in this runner. Efficient has no decode fallback.

After run_tuning, parent recommendation_file may point to record.recommendation_path; registry id must match the parent's model id.
